about: ThermoPro TP17 cooling after a roast, filmed on an iPhone in daylight with the backlight on. A reddish reflection drifts over the right-hand digit for the first 17 s. Frames are every 2nd frame of a 30 fps 960x540 video, cropped to 400x170 at (330,320).
digitBoxNote: A tight box around the three digits, in pixels of these frames: what a user would draw. The app widens it to the left by 0.7 x its height (expandBoxForDigits), which here takes in the SET TEMP degree sign and F.
changesNote: The display shows `value` from time t (seconds) until the next entry. It refreshes every 0.5 s. A change takes about 70 ms for segments turning on and up to 200 ms for the ghost of segments turning off, so from 0.07 s before a change to 0.2 s after it either the old or the new value is a correct read.
labelled: By eye from the 30 fps frames, cross-checked against the reader where it read.
